app.name: Ahd
app.tagline: A calm companion for prayer times

common.resetSectionConfirm: Reset all options in this section to their defaults?

home.title: Prayer times
home.degraded: Some times cannot be calculated normally at this latitude today; the nearest valid day is used.
home.noLocationBody: Choose your city so Ahd can calculate today’s prayer times.

tune.title: Fine-tune {{prayer}}
tune.subtitle: Match your mosque or the official timetable. Offsets are saved for this location.
tune.officialHint: Type the time from your mosque or ministry; Ahd computes the offset in seconds.

language.title: Welcome to Ahd
language.subtitle: Choose the language of the app. You can change it later.

location.title: Where are you?
location.subtitle: Search for your city, town or neighbourhood.
location.searchOnlineHint: Looks up streets and neighbourhoods with OpenStreetMap. Your search is sent only when you press the button.
location.noResults: No places found. Try another spelling or search online.
location.detectHint: Uses your system’s location service. Nothing is sent anywhere.
location.detectFailed: Your location could not be detected. Search for your city instead.
location.invalidCoordinates: Latitude must be between −90 and 90, longitude between −180 and 180.
location.mapHint: Drag the pin to your exact position.
location.franceChoice: Mosques in France follow different conventions. Which one does yours use?

times.title: Today’s prayer times
times.subtitle: Adjust any prayer by minutes or seconds so it matches your local mosque.
times.note: Times are calculated astronomically. Adjust them to match your local mosque.

theme.title: Choose a look
theme.subtitle: Ahd follows your system by default.

widgets.title: On your desktop
widgets.subtitle: Keep the time of prayer in view.
widgets.indicator: Show the prayer indicator in the taskbar or top panel
widgets.indicatorHint: Current or next prayer and its time
widgets.gnomeTitle: Your desktop may hide tray icons
widgets.gnomeBody: On GNOME, install the “AppIndicator and KStatusNotifierItem Support” extension to see Ahd in the top bar.
widgets.mainHint: All times, time elapsed and remaining
widgets.miniHint: Only the prayer and its timer — tiny and discreet

adhan.title: Adhan and notifications
adhan.subtitle: Ahd plays the adhan at each prayer time, even when its window is closed.

startup.title: Always on time
startup.subtitle: Ahd works quietly in the background.
startup.startWithSystem: Start Ahd when I log in
startup.keepInTray: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
startup.keepInTrayHint: Needed for the adhan to play when the window is closed.

done.title: All set
done.body: Ahd will call the adhan at each prayer time. You can change everything later in Settings.

general.languageDesc: The language of the whole app, including widgets and notifications.
general.startWithSystemDesc: Open Ahd in the background when you log in.
general.keepInTrayDesc: Closing the window keeps Ahd running so the adhan still plays.
general.checkUpdatesDesc: Look for a new version on GitHub once a day.
general.storeUpdates: Updates are delivered by your app store.

location.currentDesc: Prayer times are calculated for this place.
location.savedDesc: Switch quickly between places you often visit. Each keeps its own offsets.
location.timezoneDesc: Automatic uses the zone of the chosen place.
location.dstDesc: Adds one hour to the fixed offset.
location.noTransition: No daylight saving changes in this zone.
location.elevationDesc: Optional, in metres. Not used by the standard methods.

calc.methodDesc: The convention used by your country or mosque.
calc.asrDesc: When an object’s shadow reaches its length (Standard) or twice its length (Hanafi).
calc.highLatDesc: How Fajr and Isha are estimated when twilight lasts all night.
calc.offsetsDesc: Fine adjustment in seconds for this location.
calc.officialDesc: Import your ministry’s or mosque’s timetable. Listed days replace the calculation.
calc.imsakDesc: Shown before Fajr during Ramadan (minutes before Fajr).
calc.hijriOffsetDesc: Many countries start the month by local moon sighting.
calc.hijriAtMaghribDesc: The Islamic day begins at sunset.
calc.jumuahLabelDesc: Label Dhuhr as Jumuʿah every Friday.

importErrors.missingColumn: this column is missing from the header
importErrors.badDate: the date must be written as YYYY-MM-DD
importErrors.badTime: the time must be written as HH:MM or HH:MM:SS

timer.thresholdDesc: Show the time remaining when the next prayer is this close.
timer.includeSunriseDesc: Sunrise ends Fajr time; count down to it too.
timer.secondsTaskbarDesc: Updating every second uses a little more power.

adhan.perPrayerDesc: Choose what happens at each prayer time.
adhan.fajrSoundDesc: A separate adhan with «الصلاة خير من النوم».
adhan.soundsDesc: Built-in adhans and the ones you add.
adhan.addCustomDesc: MP3, OGG, FLAC, WAV or M4A, up to 30 MB. The file is copied into Ahd.
adhan.shortcutDesc: Works everywhere, even when Ahd is hidden.
adhan.shortcutTaken: This shortcut is used by another app.
adhan.fullscreen: Mute when a full-screen app is active
adhan.fullscreenDesc: For presentations and films. The notification is still shown.
adhan.dnd: Respect Do Not Disturb / Focus assist
adhan.dndDesc: The adhan is important, so this is off by default: when on, Ahd stays silent while your system is in Do Not Disturb.
adhan.missedDesc: If the computer wakes up this many minutes after a prayer, still play the adhan. Later, only a quiet notification is shown.
adhan.testDesc: Plays the Dhuhr adhan with its notification and window.
adhan.importError: This file could not be imported: {{message}}
adhan.tooLarge: The file is larger than 30 MB.
adhan.notAudio: This file is not a supported audio file.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.desc: Notifications before or after each prayer. All reminders are off by default.
reminders.messagePlaceholder: Leave empty for the default message
reminders.presetSunrise: Sunrise warning 20 minutes before (end of Fajr time)
reminders.presetFriday: Friday: 1 hour before Jumuʿah and Surat al-Kahf in the morning
reminders.kahf: Remind me to read Surat al-Kahf

appearance.themeDesc: Light, dark or the same as your system.
appearance.paletteDesc: Every palette stays soft and readable.
appearance.contrastLow: Contrast is low for some text
appearance.patternDesc: A faint eight-point star lattice on large surfaces.

widgets.lockDesc: Prevent moving the widget by accident.
widgets.pinDesktopDesc: Keeps the widget visible after “Show desktop” (Windows).
widgets.indicatorDesc: The current or next prayer and its time, always visible.
widgets.dynamicIconDesc: The tray icon shows the minutes left before the next prayer.
widgets.pillDesc: A small label beside the clock showing “Asr +1:12”.
widgets.panelLabelDesc: Text next to the tray icon in the top panel.
widgets.hideTrayDesc: Only possible while the taskbar indicator is on.
widgets.waylandDesc: On Wayland, apps cannot place their own windows, so the widget may appear in the middle of the screen. Compatibility mode runs Ahd through XWayland for full positioning (text may look slightly blurry with fractional scaling).
widgets.restartNeeded: Ahd will restart to apply this.
widgets.noTrayDesc: Your desktop does not show tray icons. On GNOME install the “AppIndicator and KStatusNotifierItem Support” extension.
widgets.mainDesc: Prayer times and the timer, always in view.
widgets.miniDesc: A tiny floating label with the current or next prayer and its timer.
widgets.layerDesc: Behind your windows like a desktop widget, or floating above all apps.

privacy.networkDesc: Ahd works fully offline. Each online feature can be turned off.
privacy.exportDesc: Save everything to a JSON file.
privacy.importDesc: Restore from a file exported by Ahd.
privacy.resetAppDesc: Erase all settings and data and start again.
privacy.resetConfirm: This erases all settings, locations, bookmarks and downloads. Continue?
privacy.noTelemetry: No accounts, no analytics, no ads. Your location stays on this computer.

about.nameMeaning: The name Ahd (عهد, “covenant”) comes from the hadith:

quran.riwayaDesc: The recitation used when the reader opens.
quran.arrowsDesc: In a printed mushaf the next page is on the left.
quran.tafsirDesc: Downloaded on demand and shown beside the text.

adhkarSettings.notificationsDesc: The same switch as at the top of the Adhkar page.
adhkarSettings.periodic: A gentle reminder to remember Allah
adhkarSettings.periodicDesc: Shows one short dhikr from the collection, between Fajr and Isha.
adhkarSettings.autoAdvance: Move to the next dhikr when a count is complete

library.downloadsDesc: Books are stored in the app data folder.
library.refreshDesc: Get the latest list of books from the project repository.

notify.sunriseWarning: Sunrise in {{minutes}} — Fajr time is ending

errors.networkDisabled: This online feature is turned off in Settings → Privacy & data.
errors.rateLimited: Please wait a moment before searching again.

adhkar.title: Adhkar
adhkar.completed: All adhkar of this session are completed.

qibla.title: Qibla
qibla.noCompass: Your computer has no compass. Use one of these methods:
qibla.sunBody: At these moments the sun is exactly in line with the qibla.
qibla.faceSun: face the sun: you face the qibla
qibla.backToSun: turn your back to the sun: you face the qibla
qibla.noSunToday: The sun does not line up with the qibla here today while it is up. Use the other methods.
qibla.rasdBody: Twice a year the sun passes almost straight over the Kaaba. At that moment, anywhere the sun is up, a vertical object's shadow points directly away from the qibla.
qibla.declEast: Here magnetic north is {{degrees}} east of true north.
qibla.declWest: Here magnetic north is {{degrees}} west of true north.
qibla.phoneBody: On a magnetic compass, the qibla is at {{degrees}}.

soon.quranTitle: The Quran reader is being prepared
